CollocationBlockingReason.description: Specific scientific reason codes preventing valid observation-to-model collocation.
CollocationBlockingReason.title: CollocationBlockingReason

description:
Authoritative contract defining whether an observation entity (profile or trajectory cast)
can be scientifically collocated with a target 3D model volume or 2D grid field.

blocking_reasons.description: List of blocking reasons if is_collocation_ready is False. Empty or [NO_BLOCKING_REASON] if ready.
blocking_reasons.title: Blocking Reasons

collocation_id.description: Unique identifier for this collocation readiness evaluation.
collocation_id.title: Collocation Id

is_collocation_ready.description: True if all spatial, temporal, physical unit, and QC checks pass with zero blockers.
is_collocation_ready.title: Is Collocation Ready

max_allowed_spatial_radius_km.description: Configured maximum allowable spatial search radius in kilometers.
max_allowed_spatial_radius_km.title: Max Allowed Spatial Radius Km

max_allowed_time_window_seconds.description: Configured maximum allowable temporal tolerance for collocation (e.g. 24 hours = 86400s).
max_allowed_time_window_seconds.title: Max Allowed Time Window Seconds

model_dataset_id.description: Identifier of the candidate model dataset (e.g. 'copernicus_phy_thetao').
model_dataset_id.title: Model Dataset Id

notes.description: Human-readable diagnostics or notes regarding the collocation readiness check.
notes.title: Notes

qc_passed.description: Whether the observation record satisfies minimum QC quality filters.
qc_passed.title: Qc Passed

spatial_distance_to_model_domain_km.description: Distance from observation location to nearest model valid grid boundary (0 if inside).
spatial_distance_to_model_domain_km.title: Spatial Distance To Model Domain Km

temporal_offset_seconds.description: Absolute time difference between observation timestamp and nearest model timestep in seconds.
temporal_offset_seconds.title: Temporal Offset Seconds

unit_conversion_required.description: Whether a mathematical or affine unit conversion is required prior to comparison.
unit_conversion_required.title: Unit Conversion Required

title: CollocationReadinessContract
